select ETR_ENTRUST.ENTRUST_ID entrustId, ETR_ENTRUST.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName, ETR_ENTRUST_ADD.ASSET_TYPE1 assetType1,
ETR_ENTRUST_ADD.ASSET_TYPE_10 assetType10, ETR_ENTRUST_ADD.ASSET_TYPE_11 assetType11,
ETR_ENTRUST.CHL_ID chlId, FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID finprodId, FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_NAME finprodName,
ETR_ENTRUST_ADD.SEC_ACCT_ID secAcctId,
ETR_ENTRUST.PS ps, ETR_ENTRUST.CCY ccy, ETR_ENTRUST.TRADE_MARKET tradeMarket, ETR_ENTRUST.REMARK remark, ETR_ENTRUST.VDATE vdate, ETR_ENTRUST.MDATE mdate, ETR_ENTRUST.ENTRUST_AMT entrustAmt, ETR_ENTRUST.ENTRUST_NUM entrustNum, ETR_ENTRUST.INV_MANAGER_ID invManagerId, ETR_DISTRIBUTE.TRADER trader, ETR_ENTRUST.COUNTER_ID counterId, ETR_ENTRUST.COUNTER_TRADER counterTrader, R_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID rFinprodId, R_PRODUCT.FINPROD_MARKET_ID changeToFinprodMarketId, IFNULL(R_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ABBR, R_PRODUCT.FINPROD_NAME) changeToFinprodName, ETR_ENTRUST.CONTACT_INFO contactInfo from ETR_ENTRUST left join PTL_PORTFOLIO on PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_ID = ETR_ENTRUST.PORTFOLIO_ID
left join FIN_PRODUCT on FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = ETR_ENTRUST.FINPROD_ID
inner join ETR_ENTRUST_ADD on ETR_ENTRUST_ADD.ENTRUST_ID = ETR_ENTRUST.ENTRUST_ID
LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT R_PRODUCT ON ETR_ENTRUST_ADD.R_FINPROD_ID = R_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID
left join ETR_DISTRIBUTE on ETR_DISTRIBUTE.ENTRUST_ID = ETR_ENTRUST.ENTRUST_ID where ETR_ENTRUST.ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT A.VALUATION FROM FIN_PRODUCT_VALUATION A, FIN_PRODUCT C
C.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND C.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = A.FINPROD_ID AND C.FINPROD_TYPE2 = A.FINPROD_TYPE2 and A.VAL_DATE = #{sysDate}
